extracted.intended_audience: students, researchers, policymakers, and general readers seeking country-level geographic and demographic reference data
extracted.subtask_description: A country-by-country reference listing that provides (1) natural resource endowments, (2) estimated net migration rates (per 1,000 population, 2004 est.), and (3) brief geography notes describing physical features or strategic location. Intended as a factual reference for comparative or background use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural resources (by country)
rubrics_metrics.description: A per-country listing of natural resources and notable economic/physical assets (e.g., 'Latvia: peat, limestone, dolomite, amber, hydropower, wood, arable land'; some entries show 'NEGL' for negligible).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries list commodities, minerals, energy sources, arable land, fisheries, hydropower potential, and other exploitable assets. Some country lines include 'note:' annotations about unexploited or suspected deposits (e.g., Mali: known but not exploited deposits). 'NEGL' denotes negligible resources. The listing includes a global note about depletion of nonrenewable resources and environmental degradation. Page last updated date is provided (10 February, 2005).

rubrics_metrics.name: Net migration rate (migrant(s)/1,000 population)
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated net migration rate per 1,000 population for each country/territory, annotated with the date of estimate (2004 est.) and values that may be positive, negative, zero, or 'NA'. Example: 'Afghanistan 23.06 migrant(s)/1,000 population (2004 est.)'; 'Albania -4.93 migrant(s)/1,000 population (2004 est.)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values are presented country-by-country and frequently accompanied by short explanatory notes where relevant (e.g., refugee flows, major migration destinations, repatriation efforts). 'NA' denotes not available. The estimates are labeled with the year (2004) and sometimes include contextual footnotes explaining unusual values or regional refugee situations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - note (per country)
rubrics_metrics.description: Concise geography notes for each country/territory highlighting physical geography, strategic location, notable landforms, climate or special status (e.g., 'Afghanistan: landlocked; the Hindu Kush mountains...'; 'Australia: world's smallest continent but sixth-largest country; population concentrated along the eastern and southeastern coasts').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes emphasize factors of physical and strategic importance (landlocked status, strategic straits/harbors, major mountains, islands' characteristics, climate elements). They are country-specific, often mentioning features that affect population distribution, transport, or geopolitical significance. These entries are prose-style explanatory remarks rather than numeric metrics.
